text:
Anya: Heads up — we're seeing a recurring tail latency spike (P99 ~1.6s, baseline ~800ms) on prod continuous-batching since ~02:10 UTC. Spikes coincide with bursts from tenant pub-data-7.
Mike: I saw the alert. Is this the kernel-selector rollout (c3f8a6) from yesterday? @Sam can you pull selector logs + admission traces?
Sam: grabbing logs now. kernel_selector.log shows repeated "fallthrough to generic_kernel" for microbatch sizes 17-22, reason=unsupported_fused_ops. Latency histograms for those batch sizes are ~2x.
Yun: KV cache dashboard shows miss_rate jumped ~3x during the same window and eviction_rate increased. Could be shard imbalance causing cache thrash under bursts.
ProfilingBot: sampled-profiles @02:12 (30 samples): generic_kernel median cpu_time 42ms vs fused_kernel 22ms. Top stack: kernel_dispatch -> attn_impl_generic -> matmul.
Anya: Can we reproduce in staging with pub-data-7 load profile? I'm spinning a local generator against staging runtime.
Sam: Repro recipe: force kernel_selector to prefer fused kernel and run a 5m burst. If P99 improves, that points to selector fallback being root cause.
Mike: Also note admission changes rolled in earlier today: aggressive packer enabled (max_microbatch=32, pack_threshold_ms=5). If packer fragments batches (sizes 17-22) that could trigger unsupported_fused branch.
Sam: Quick toggles to try locally:
```
export KERNEL_SELECTOR_PREFER_FUSED=1
export KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1
./run_load --tenant pub-data-7 --qps 120 --seq 512 --duration 300
# runtime config: admission.max_microbatch=32
# admission.pack_threshold_ms=5
```
Luca: I can see infra change infra/pack-opts merged ~10h ago. That PR adjusted pack_threshold_ms and introduced the new aggressive packing heuristic.
Anya: Proposed immediate plan:
1) Canary revert kernel-selector change c3f8a6 to last-known-good in 10% canary pool.
2) Run 10m golden traffic + pub-data-7 replay, monitor P95/P99 and KV miss_rate.
3) If good, rollback fully and schedule a follow-up: add selector guard + metrics.
InfraBot: Canary rollback job created for canary pool, start in ~5m, will auto-stop at 03:00 UTC unless canceled.
Yun: If canary shows KV miss_rate / P99 normalizing we'll coordinate limited rollback. Also we should inspect shard placement for pub-data-7 — looks skewed on a couple of nodes during the window.
Sam: Long-term actions: add explicit guard in kernel_selector to avoid falling back for batch sizes that we've observed cause huge latency deltas. Also emit metric: fallback_rate_by_batch_size and fused_capability_by_model. I'll open a ticket.
Mike: I'll own the immediate bugfix ticket and add sampled-profiling traces to the APM dashboard. Also will run a few staging runs with the aggressive packer to see fragmentation distribution.
Anya: Quick note — if canary fails, our rollback order is: revert admission packer tweak (infra pack-opts) -> limit pub-data-7 to dedicated pool -> full selector rollback.
Sam: Canary finished: P99 returned to baseline, KV miss_rate normalized during canary window. Sampling shows fused_kernel chosen more often with prefer_fused toggle.
Anya: Great. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Follow-ups: Luca to coordinate infra revert PR if we see recurrence; Sam/Mike to add selector guard + metrics.
Luca: Filed infra follow-up (internal/infra#412) to add metric for packer fragmentation and add canary flags to packer.
ProfilingBot: Note: adding fallback_rate_by_batch_size to next deployment.
Mike: Created runtime/selector#221 with proposed guard + tests.
Anya: Thanks all. Closing thread — post any slow-roll updates in the rollout ticket.
